other_failure_modes.name: Ignoring dataset ID column
other_failure_modes.description: The agent generates a synthetic sequence for the ID column in the submission file using np.arange() instead of extracting the actual ID column from the test dataset. If the test IDs are not contiguous or do not start at 0, this will misalign predictions and potentially fail evaluation.

summary: The agent provides a robust data science solution with solid feature engineering (TF-IDF, SVD, frequency encoding, keyword counts), appropriate leakage prevention (fitting transformers after splitting), and an inverse-error weighted ensemble. However, it fails to account for variance by evaluating its stochastic models only once and relies entirely on RMSE for evaluation. More critically, it generates synthetic IDs for the final submission instead of using the provided test set IDs, which could cause grading failures.
